messages:
Jordan: paging oncall — seeing spike in 500s for /v1/generate starting ~14:02 UTC. Error rate ~12% for last 8m. Latency also creeping up. I’m on it but flagging here. @oncall-bot please escalate if not acknowledged in 2m

oncall-bot: Incident page created: INC-2167778888. Pager sent to the on-call rotation. Link: https://infra.redwood/INC-2167778888 :rotating_light:

Sofia: I can help with logs. Which host pool is seeing this? gpu-pool-3?

Jordan: yes gpu-pool-3. Rolling deploy to that pool finished ~13:45 UTC. I’m tailing nginx + runtime logs now.

Priya: I’m pulling the status-page draft. Quick Q: is this customer-impacting for all customers or only Dedicated?

Jordan: Probably all hosted customers in us-west-2 hitting that model route. Embeddings endpoints OK.

DevOps: seeing repeated OOMs in runtime logs around 14:01-14:05 on node gpu-3-7. Also a few RPC timeouts to kv-cache. Kernel OOMs correlate.

Sofia: copying relevant logs below:

```
[14:02:03] runtime ERROR: failed to allocate tensor: cudaMalloc returned out of memory
[14:02:04] nginx 502 upstream read timeout while reading response header from upstream
[14:02:06] runtime WARN: KV cache miss spike, fallback to model recompute
```

Priya: Draft status-page update (customer-facing). Please review tone + placeholders: 

```
Status: Identified — Partial degradation of text generation in US-West-2
Impact: A subset of API requests to /v1/generate may receive 5xx responses or higher latency. Not impacting embeddings or data plane for Dedicated customers with pinned capacity.
ETA: Investigating — next update in 15 minutes
Details: We are actively investigating increased error rates impacting generation requests and are working to restore normal service. No customer data exposure has been observed.
```

Jordan: I’d soften "Not impacting Dedicated" to "Primarily impacting hosted workloads; Dedicated customers may be unaffected depending on routing config" — we shouldn’t overpromise. Also add a suggested workaround: retry with shorter max_new_tokens.

Priya: updated draft with wording tweak. Also wrote internal comms template for SRE -> Eng lead handoff. Sharing here, feel free to edit: 

```
Internal incident note (SRE -> Eng lead):
- Incident ID: INC-2167778888
- First seen: 2026-03-15T14:02:00Z
- Affected service: inference-runtime (gpu-pool-3)
- Impact summary: ~12% 5xx on /v1/generate in us-west-2; latency increased by ~250ms p95
- Initial hypothesis: recent kernel change + memory fragmentation leading to OOMs and KV-cache RPC degradation
- Actions taken: rollbacks considered, restarting affected runtime pods, draining node gpu-3-7
- Next steps (proposed): stabilize nodes, revert last runtime commit (sha: ab12c3), increase KV-cache timeouts, follow up on root cause analysis
- Customer communication: post status-page draft to status.redwood.com; prepare PSR if impact lasts >2h
- On-call: Jordan
```

Sofia: Nice. For tone: use active voice, avoid technical jargon in the customer-facing copy, but internal note should have the hypothesis and exact logs.

incident-bot: Suggested actions: restart runtime on gpu-3-7; temporarily evict long-running sessions; enable degraded mode to reduce max context size. Use `/incident action restart-node gpu-3-7` to perform an automated rolling restart.

Jordan: Running restart now. Command: `/incident action restart-node gpu-3-7`

oncall-bot: Action acknowledged: scheduled restart of gpu-3-7 in 30s. Estimated node offline 90s.

DevOps: restart finished. Node came back 14:08 UTC. Early signal: error rate dropped to ~4% but not back to baseline. KV-cache timeouts still present.

Priya: Updated status page to: 

```
Status: Mitigating — Partial degradation affecting text generation in US-West-2
Impact: A subset of API requests to /v1/generate may receive 5xx responses or increased latency. Embeddings unaffected.
Mitigation: Restarted affected node; traffic is being rebalanced. We are continuing to monitor and will provide another update within 30 minutes.
```

Jordan: Good. Preparing handoff note for the night shift. Handoff bullet points: what we tried, current signal, next diagnostic steps (heap dumps, kv-cache tracer, revert runtime commit if errors persist), contact list.

Priya: Handoff note (final):

```
Handoff for Night Shift — INC-2167778888
- Summary: Memory allocation failures on gpu-pool-3 caused increased 5xx for generation routes. Restart reduced errors but KV-cache timeouts persist.
- Current status: Mitigating; partial recovery; p95 latency remains ~+120ms vs baseline.
- Things to monitor: error rate, kv-cache RPC latency, node memory usage, pending restarts
- Escalation path: if >10% error rate persists for 30m, escalate to Eng Runtime (page @SRE-ENG) and consider reverting runtime commit ab12c3.
- Artifacts: attached logs + heap dump link: https://logs.redwood/INC-2167778888/heapdump.tgz
- Owner for next shift: Sofia
```

Sofia: Got it. I’ll pick this up. Leaving a note for customer success: prepare proactive outreach for top 10 customers in us-west-2 if we don’t hit baseline in 60m.

Jordan: Thanks everyone. Final note for templates: can we add a "sensitivity" tag to customer messages to indicate when legal/security must be looped? e.g., low/medium/high. Priya — can you add that to the wording library?

Priya: Yep — adding a "Sensitivity: low/medium/high" placeholder to the internal template. Will update the comms library this afternoon. :memo:
